findings.finding: Initial command rows were added only after child return; launch and timeout attempts could be absent from the aggregate evidence.
findings.resolution: A PENDING row is appended before log allocation/launch. Failure type, ERROR status and shutdown fields are retained and the row is printed in the finalizer. Partial logs remain evidence.

findings.finding: An unguarded postflight manifest failure could mask the original failure and prevent composite results from being written.
findings.resolution: Postflight hashing/writing is separately guarded. The result document records the original error type and independent postflight error type, and input equality cannot pass when the postflight fails. Exclusive result-file writing is attempted even after preflight, child or postflight errors.

findings.finding: TMPDIR shape alone did not establish a real owned running coordinated lane or exact command.
findings.resolution: TMPDIR, scratch and cycle directories must be existing canonical directories owned by the current UID. The bounded regular current-UID lane receipt is opened O_NOFOLLOW and must be RUNNING with the matching cycle and exact /usr/bin/python3 -B packet command.

findings.finding: Default SIGTERM exit bypassed Python finalization; asynchronous interruption during child assignment also needed explicit handling.
findings.resolution: The installed SIGINT/SIGTERM handler records pending signals during launch, defers signals during child shutdown and packet finalization, and raises otherwise. A returned child is finalized after a pending launch signal. Pending/deferred signals prevent a success exit.

findings.finding: subprocess.run timeout immediately kills the child, preventing the composition-control launcher's external temporary-parent finalizer from running. Outer scratch deletion cannot prove retirement of that external allocation.
findings.resolution: Popen waits at most600 seconds; a live child receives TERM and20 seconds before KILL and a further5-second wait. Escalation and shutdown errors are retained. Composition KILL escalation sets external_cleanup_requires_inspection rather than declaring external cleanup successful.
findings.remaining_limit: Actual signal delivery, descendant cleanup and external-parent retirement must be judged from raw execution/finalizer evidence. SIGKILL or infrastructure failure cannot be made successful by this synthetic source review.

source_conclusions: No argument-controlled test selection, shell invocation or publication path. Exactly nine fixed entries: packet, lane, single-tap, schema-bootstrap, toolchain, functional-copy, composition, normal, schema-closure.
The driver requires -B and no arguments. Each child uses explicit /usr/bin/python3 -B, the repository cwd, an exclusive binary log and the inherited coordinator-owned scratch environment.

Control manifests hash exact regular-file bytes with a4MiB bound and canonical-path checks; traversed symlinks are rejected. Entries are sorted and exclusive output creation preserves preexisting evidence rather than overwriting it.
Child nonzero exit remains FAIL; other attempted failures remain ERROR with original row error information. A source drift or missing/erroring postflight cannot pass even if all children exited0.
Return0 additionally requires a complete fixed command set and no pending/deferred signals. Outer source manifests and finalizer receipts still need independent reconciliation.

The last one-line packet-test addition changes no previously reviewed command, custody, hashing, exception or cleanup behavior. Synthetic controls use fake Popen objects; the packet suite does not recurse into another actual lane.
